title: Writing / Style / Don't capitalize
slide_intent: Leave ordinary product vocabulary in lowercase so common activities do not acquire unnecessary formality.
strategic_value: Contrasting generic terms with the preceding naming chart can help Duolingo keep its language approachable.
demonstration: Four groups list earned items, non-specific course parts, UI/UX terms and content items, with lowercase examples.
practical_value: Determine whether the word is a generic reference rather than the proper name of a feature.

content_islands.name: Worked examples
content_islands.spec: Arrange four category groups at right; retain the examples that use lowercase stories and achievements generically.

reference_purposes.Intent: The source explicitly links lowercase treatment with approachability.
reference_purposes.Application: The chart demonstrates lowercase terms in example sentences.
reference_purposes.Constraint: Earned items, non-specific course parts, generic UI/UX references and individual content items remain lowercase in the displayed contexts.

ingredient.name: Lowercase generic product terms
ingredient.role: Keep everyday activities and objects approachable.
ingredient.application: Use lowercase for generic earned items, course parts, UI/UX references and content items.
ingredient.scope: Historical official guidelines from the 2024–2025 archived snapshot; this records the displayed guidance, not current Duolingo product behavior. The same word can be capitalized as a feature name elsewhere; preserve the chart’s generic-versus-named distinction.
